class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.frame.width = 20
        vector = Vector([3, 4], color=BLUE)
        basis_vector1 = Vector([1, 0], color=RED)
        basis_vector2 = Vector([0, 1], color=GREEN)
        self.add(vector, basis_vector1, basis_vector2)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.scale(1.5), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)
        vector_label = MathTex("\\overrightarrow{v} = (3, 4)").next_to(vector, UP)
        basis_vector1_label = MathTex("\\hat{i}").next_to(basis_vector1, UP)
        basis_vector2_label = MathTex("\\hat{j}").next_to(basis_vector2, UP)
        self.play(Write(vector_label), Write(basis_vector1_label), Write(basis_vector2_label))
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(vector).scale(0.5), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
        vector_components = MathTex("(3, 4) = 3\\hat{i} + 4\\hat{j}").shift(UP * 2)
        self.play(Write(vector_components))
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(vector_label, basis_vector1_label, basis_vector2_label, vector_components), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.scale(2), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
        vector_addition = MathTex("\\overrightarrow{u} + \\overrightarrow{v} = (1 + 3, 2 + 4) = (4, 6)").shift(DOWN * 2)
        self.play(Write(vector_addition))
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(vector_addition), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.5), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(vector, basis_vector1, basis_vector2), run_time=2)
